social_media_video_game.name: Social Media is a Video Game
social_media_video_game.when: When analyzing platform dynamics or choosing where to invest time
social_media_video_game.principle: Each platform has mechanics. Learn them or play in hard mode.
key_questions: What game am I playing? (which platform, what audience)
What are the cheat codes? (format, timing, hooks that work)
Is this game rigged or fair? (does extra effort map to extra reward?)

steps: Open curiosity loop in viewer's mind
Take IVA (Ideal Viewer Avatar), imagine pain point
Open curiosity loop around that pain point
They have to listen for the next line

linkedin_shorts_cheat_code.name: LinkedIn Shorts Cheat Code
linkedin_shorts_cheat_code.when: When creating short-form video for LinkedIn specifically
rules: Quality bar is LOWEST on LinkedIn — no editing required
Process: 5 topics → write first sentences → record → post

key_tactics: People overvalue the edit — value trumps production quality every time
Corporate jobs are rigged games — find platforms where extra effort maps to extra reward
The reason you feel like an imposter as a beginner: you haven't had enough reps yet
Every coach tells you to do the same thing — find what they're NOT saying
Start with end in mind to avoid dead audience traps
Modern content stack beats old production-heavy approaches
